name: Select Other
description: Widget for core List fields offering the configured options plus an 'Other' choice that reveals a free-text field.
provides_plugin_types: Field widget: cck_select_other (SelectOtherWidget) — for list_integer, list_float, list_string
Field formatter: cck_select_other (SelectOtherFormatter) — for the same three list types
Views filter: select_other (SelectOtherFilter) — extends the core options ListField filter
Validation constraint override: AllowedValues (SelectOtherAllowedValuesConstraint + validator) — replaces core's plugin site-wide via hook_validation_constraint_alter
project_description:
CCK Select Other provides a form widget for Drupal core List fields (list_string, list_integer, list_float; not list_boolean) that renders the field's configured allowed values as a select list with an added 'Other' option. Choosing 'Other' reveals a text input (toggled by a small jQuery behavior) into which the user types a value that is not in the list. The typed value is stored directly into the same list field. A matching field formatter, and a Views filter that adds the 'Other' option to exposed filters, are also provided. The widget setting is a customizable label for the 'Other' option (default 'Other').

Because Drupal decouples fields from widgets, a widget cannot normally relax a field's allowed-values validation. To make the free-text 'Other' value pass field validation, the module replaces core's AllowedValues validation constraint plugin site-wide (hook_validation_constraint_alter) with its own subclass and validator. For any List field that has this widget configured on at least one of its entity form displays, the submitted value is added to the constraint's allowed choices at validation time, so arbitrary values are accepted; for all other List fields the validator reproduces core's behavior. This is documented, intentional behavior (the module's README states 'Any field that has an instance using this widget will bypass allowed values').

A direct successor to the classic Drupal 6/7 CCK 'Select (or other)' widget (the 'cck_' prefix). The 2.0.x branch targets Drupal 11.3+ / 12 and is an alpha release.
